results.title: 8 best Relevance AI alternatives and competitors in 2026
results.content:
Here are the best Relevance AI alternatives:

1. Gumloop
2. n8n
3. Sintra AI
4. Zapier
5. Lindy AI
6. Workato
7. StackAI
8. Chatbase

Okay, let’s take a deeper look at each one.

### 1. Gumloop

 Best for: Building AI-powered workflows and agents without code
 Pricing: Free plan available, paid plans start at $37/month
 What I like: Access to premium LLMs without needing your own API keys

Gumloop is an AI automation and agent builder. It allows you to create automated workflows by connecting your existing tools in your tech stack. But from there, it also adds an AI layer, using any model like ChatGPT, Claude, DeepSeek, etc., on top of your tools to make decisions on your behalf. [...] The people who lose jobs to AI are the ones who refuse to work with it. Employers don't want workers who are scared of AI. They want people who can use these tools to 10x their output and solve problems faster.

And let's be real about the layoffs. When companies say "we're cutting jobs because of AI," it's usually just an excuse to fix overhiring. They were going to make those cuts anyway. Blaming AI just sounds better in a press release.

So instead of worrying about AI taking your job, learn how to use it. Pick one of the tools from this list and automate something this week. Even if it's small. That's how you stay ahead.

The future of work isn't humans vs. AI. It's humans with AI vs. humans without it.

Don't be in the latter.

Gmail, Slack, Sheets, and Outlook icons [...] Here's what I like about Gumloop:

 You don't need LLM API keys to get started (but you can add your own if you want)
 The Gummie AI assistant can help you build any workflow simply by talking to it in natural language
 You can leverage MCP to connect to almost any tool
 The platform comes with a handful of pre-built templates to get started

Here are some things that can improve:

 It's still a new tool, so the UI can shift at times as they add new features
 I do wish they had more templates, but Gummie fills the gap by creating any workflow for you

Overall, if you're looking for a solid Relevance AI alternative, I can't recommend Gumloop enough. The free plan is also super generous, and you can build your first few workflows without having to pay for a premium plan.

results.title: Consultation on Artificial Intelligence and Competition: What We Heard
results.content:
Respondents did note that small and medium enterprises (SMEs) can leverage compute resources from other firms to save on up-front costs. Inputs in this case include cloud computing and data. Providers of AI infrastructure vary from well-established large firms like Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft (Azure), Google (Cloud) Oracle, and IBM, to alternative providers like CoreWeave and open-source platforms such as Hugging Face.Footnote 12

Still, large firms have high control over the input layer of the AI technology stack, giving them potentially significant market power compared to alternate providers.

##### Counter argument to AI inputs favouring large firms [...] Many submissions note that startup companies are steadily emerging and growing in the AI sector, despite the positions of large companies within input markets (the markets of companies that produce and supply AI inputs such as computer chips and supercomputers). Strategies such as “Retrieval Augmented Generation” (RAG),Footnote 3 pre-training, and fine-tuning are driving access, growth, and productivity in AI model development, as these strategies use less data and computation time to create models, and are much faster than traditional methods, paving the way for new entrants.Footnote 4 Other growth factors include increased investments, emerging partnerships, rising market demand, and access to alternative compute suppliers like CoreWeave,Footnote 5 and open-source providers.
